top_failure_modes.title: Combined Downside Breaks Guardrails
top_failure_modes.affected_clause: discounts / rebates / service credits / support obligations
top_failure_modes.why_it_fails: Multiple concessions stack in the same scenario and push margin below target.
top_failure_modes.recommended_remediation_category: Reduce concession stacking and add minimum commitment
top_failure_modes.explanation: Contract term: discounts, rebates, credits, and support costs are evaluated together. In Downside commercial scenario, multiple concessions stack in the same scenario and push margin below target. The deterministic calculation shows scenario margin 33.76% vs target 55.0%, creating ₹5,14,419.00 annual exposure. The consequence is reduced downside protection before signature.

top_failure_modes.title: Infrastructure Inflation Outruns Pricing
top_failure_modes.why_it_fails: Cost multiplier increases total delivery cost without matching price protection.
top_failure_modes.recommended_remediation_category: Add cost-indexed uplift or usage-based pricing floor
top_failure_modes.explanation: Contract term: renewal escalation 8, overage price 0.2. In Infrastructure-cost increase, cost multiplier increases total delivery cost without matching price protection. The deterministic calculation shows scenario margin 47.35% vs target 55.0%, creating ₹2,26,356.00 annual exposure. The consequence is reduced downside protection before signature.

top_failure_modes.title: Service Credits Amplify Downside
top_failure_modes.why_it_fails: Lower SLA performance triggers credits while support and infrastructure costs rise.
top_failure_modes.recommended_remediation_category: Narrow credit triggers and cap monthly service credits
top_failure_modes.explanation: Contract term: SLA threshold 99.5, service credits 5. In SLA degradation, lower sla performance triggers credits while support and infrastructure costs rise. The deterministic calculation shows scenario margin 51.62% vs target 55.0%, creating ₹95,055.00 annual exposure. The consequence is reduced downside protection before signature.
